# Trace

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Diagnostics` · class

```csharp
public static class Trace
```

Diagnostic messages, each with a tag: a number unique in the source, so a message can be found from a log.

## Properties

### MinLevel

```csharp
public static TraceLevel MinLevel { get; set; }
```

Types: [`TraceLevel`](TraceLevel.md)

The least important messages that are written: [`TraceLevel.Information`](TraceLevel.md#information) unless a game changes it, as a release build might to [`TraceLevel.Warning`](TraceLevel.md#warning).

### Writer

```csharp
public static ITraceWriter Writer { get; set; }
```

Types: [`ITraceWriter`](ITraceWriter.md)

Where trace output goes. By default it's written to `Diagnostics.Trace`. Replace it to send the output to your own logging.

## Events

### FatalException

```csharp
public static event EventHandler<FatalExceptionEventArgs>? FatalException;
```

Types: [`FatalExceptionEventArgs`](FatalExceptionEventArgs.md)

A fault the game can't recover from, just before the process ends: the place to save a crash report. Raised on whichever thread faulted.

### NonFatalException

```csharp
public static event EventHandler<NonFatalExceptionEventArgs>? NonFatalException;
```

Types: [`NonFatalExceptionEventArgs`](NonFatalExceptionEventArgs.md)

Raised for a failure the game runs on without, such as music that can't play, so a crash reporter can record it. Raised once per failure site per run, on whichever thread failed, so a handler must be thread-safe and quick.
